I built this to answer one question well, and to leave every other question alone.

## What changed

- The reading step now keeps the crop of every line.
- Values that do not parse are shown as "check the paper".
- Nothing is ever called normal.

```bash
IMAGE_TAG=$GITHUB_SHA bash ~/elioo-web/deploy.sh
```

Closing paragraph with a little more text so the reading time is not zero.
